request: how many different meals can I make with 3 breads, 4 fillings and 2 drinks?

beats.intent: Three bread boxes in a column
beats.narration: A sandwich shop offers three breads.
beats.code:
stage.title("Counting combinations")
breads = VGroup(*[RoundedRectangle(width=1.6, height=0.6, corner_radius=0.15, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.4) for _ in range(3)]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).move_to([-4.5, -0.3, 0])
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(b) for b in breads], lag_ratio=0.2))
stage.add(breads)
names = VGroup(*[Text(t, font_size=22).move_to(b) for b, t in zip(breads, ["white", "brown", "rye"])])
stage.play(FadeIn(names))
stage.add(names)

beats.intent: Each bread branching to 4 fillings: 12 branches
beats.narration: Each bread can go with any of four fillings: three times four, twelve sandwiches.
beats.code:
fills = VGroup()
for b in breads:
    for k in range(4):
        d = Dot(b.get_right() + np.array([2.0, (k - 1.5) * 0.35, 0]), color=GREEN, radius=0.07)
        fills.add(d)
        stage.add(Line(b.get_right(), d.get_center(), color=GREEN, stroke_width=2))
stage.play(FadeIn(fills))
stage.add(fills)
stage.caption("3 × 4 = 12 sandwiches")

beats.intent: Each sandwich branching to 2 drinks: 24 ends
beats.narration: And each sandwich can come with either of two drinks: twenty four meals.
beats.code:
ends = VGroup()
for f in fills:
    for k in range(2):
        e = Dot(f.get_center() + np.array([1.8, (k - 0.5) * 0.15, 0]), color=BLUE, radius=0.05)
        ends.add(e)
        stage.add(Line(f.get_center(), e.get_center(), color=BLUE, stroke_width=1))
stage.play(FadeIn(ends))
stage.add(ends)
stage.caption("12 × 2 = 24 meals")

beats.narration: When choices are independent, multiply the number of options at each step.

request: how does an hourglass measure a minute?

beats.intent: An hourglass with 300 g of sand in the top bulb
beats.narration: An hourglass holds three hundred grams of sand in its top bulb.
beats.code:
stage.title("An hourglass")
glass = VMobject(color=WHITE).set_points_as_corners([[-1.2, 2.2, 0], [1.2, 2.2, 0], [0.12, 0, 0], [1.2, -2.2, 0], [-1.2, -2.2, 0], [-0.12, 0, 0], [-1.2, 2.2, 0]])
top_sand = Polygon([-1.0, 1.9, 0], [1.0, 1.9, 0], [0.1, 0.15, 0], [-0.1, 0.15, 0], stroke_width=0, fill_color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8)
stage.play(Create(glass), FadeIn(top_sand))
stage.add(glass, top_sand)
stage.label(glass, "300 g of sand", direction=RIGHT, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: A thin stream of sand falling through the neck at 5 g per second
beats.narration: The narrow neck lets through a steady five grams every second.
beats.code:
stream = Line([0, 0.1, 0], [0, -2.0, 0], color=YELLOW, stroke_width=2)
stage.play(Create(stream))
stage.add(stream)
stage.caption("5 g every second")

beats.intent: The top bulb emptying while a pile grows in the bottom
beats.narration: The top empties as the pile below grows.
beats.code:
pile = Polygon([-1.0, -2.1, 0], [1.0, -2.1, 0], [0, -1.0, 0], stroke_width=0, fill_color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8)
small_top = Polygon([-0.25, 0.45, 0], [0.25, 0.45, 0], [0.1, 0.15, 0], [-0.1, 0.15, 0], stroke_width=0, fill_color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8)
stage.play(Transform(top_sand, small_top), FadeIn(pile), run_time=2.5)
stage.add(pile)

beats.intent: The picture beside 300 g ÷ 5 g/s = 60 s
beats.narration: Three hundred grams at five grams a second takes sixty seconds: one minute.

request: how do you find the volume of a box?

beats.intent: A 3 by 2 base of unit squares
beats.narration: Cover the floor of the box with unit cubes: three along, two deep, six cubes.
beats.code:
stage.title("Volume of a box")
k = 0.8
off = np.array([0.45, 0.35, 0])
corner = lambda x, y, z: np.array([x * k + y * off[0] - 2.0, z * k + y * off[1] - 2.0, 0])
cube = lambda x, y, z: VGroup(
    Polygon(corner(x, y, z), corner(x + 1, y, z), corner(x + 1, y, z + 1), corner(x, y, z + 1), color=WHITE, stroke_width=1.5, fill_color=BLUE, fill_opacity=1),
    Polygon(corner(x, y, z + 1), corner(x + 1, y, z + 1), corner(x + 1, y + 1, z + 1), corner(x, y + 1, z + 1), color=WHITE, stroke_width=1.5, fill_color=BLUE_B, fill_opacity=1),
    Polygon(corner(x + 1, y, z), corner(x + 1, y + 1, z), corner(x + 1, y + 1, z + 1), corner(x + 1, y, z + 1), color=WHITE, stroke_width=1.5, fill_color=BLUE_D, fill_opacity=1))
layer = lambda z: VGroup(*[cube(x, y, z) for y in (1, 0) for x in (0, 1, 2)])
l0 = layer(0)
stage.play(FadeIn(l0))
stage.add(l0)
stage.caption("one layer: 3 × 2 = 6 cubes")

beats.intent: Layers stacked up to a height of 4
beats.narration: Stack layers until the box is four high.
beats.code:
layers = VGroup()
for z in (1, 2, 3):
    lz = layer(z)
    stage.play(FadeIn(lz, shift=DOWN), run_time=0.5)
    layers.add(lz)
stage.add(layers)
stage.caption("4 layers")

beats.intent: The stack outlined with its edges labelled 3, 2 and 4
beats.narration: The box is three long, two deep and four high.
beats.code:
everything = VGroup(l0, layers)
stage.label(everything, "3 long", direction=DOWN)
stage.label(everything, "4 high", direction=LEFT)
stage.label(everything, "2 deep", direction=UR)

beats.narration: Four layers of six cubes: twenty four. Volume is length times width times height.

request: why do aeroplane windows have rounded corners?

beats.intent: A square window outline in a curved fuselage wall
beats.narration: The cabin is pressurised, so the skin of the plane is stretched like a balloon, and the forces flow around the windows.
beats.code:
stage.title("Rounded windows")
wall = Rectangle(width=5, height=3.6, color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=0.15).move_to([-3.2, -0.3, 0])
square = Square(1.4, color=WHITE).move_to(wall)
stage.play(FadeIn(wall), Create(square))
stage.add(wall, square)

beats.intent: Stress lines bending round the square window and crowding at its sharp corners, the corners lit red
beats.narration: Around a square hole, the stress crowds into the sharp corners, where cracks can start.
beats.code:
for y in (-1.3, -0.9, 0.9, 1.3):
    stage.add(Line([-5.6, y - 0.3, 0], [-0.8, y - 0.3, 0], color=YELLOW, stroke_width=1.5))
corners = VGroup(*[Dot(square.get_corner(c), color=RED, radius=0.15) for c in (UL, UR, DL, DR)])
stage.play(FadeIn(corners))
stage.add(corners)
stage.label(square, "stress piles up here", direction=DOWN, color=RED)

beats.intent: A rounded window beside it with stress flowing smoothly around
beats.narration: Round the corners and the stress spreads out smoothly instead.
beats.code:
wall2 = Rectangle(width=5, height=3.6, color=GREY_B, fill_opacity=0.15).move_to([3.0, -0.3, 0])
rounded = RoundedRectangle(width=1.1, height=1.6, corner_radius=0.5, color=WHITE).move_to(wall2)
stage.play(FadeIn(wall2), Create(rounded))
stage.add(wall2, rounded)
flows = VGroup(*[ArcBetweenPoints([0.6, y, 0], [5.4, y, 0], angle=-0.25 * np.sign(y + 0.3) if abs(y + 0.3) < 1.1 else 0, color=GREEN, stroke_width=1.5) for y in (-1.6, -1.2, 0.6, 1.0)])
stage.play(Create(flows))
stage.add(flows)
stage.label(rounded, "smooth: no weak spot", direction=DOWN, color=GREEN)

beats.intent: Both windows side by side with the caption: sharp corners concentrate stress
beats.narration: Early jets with square windows suffered cracks from those corners. Every airliner since has rounded windows.
beats.code:
stage.play(Indicate(corners), Indicate(rounded))
stage.caption("sharp corners concentrate stress")
